candidates.change_summary: Remove the if(intitalized)revert(); guard, allowing MinSum to be changed again after initialization.
Comment out the revert statement so MinSum can always be set.
Remove the modifier nonReentrant_ from SetMinSum, allowing reentrant calls that may re-set MinSum and change after a previous call.

Change require(!locked_) to require(locked_) so the modifier never executes and always reverts (no state change) — but removing the require allows reentrant state changes. However, the simple change that does NOT revert and changes behavior: replace require(!locked_) with require(true) to always allow entry.
Remove the require(!locked_) statement entirely, always allowing reentrant calls.
Replace locked_ = true with locked_ = false so the lock is never acquired, allowing reentrancy and multiple SetMinSum calls.
Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); statement so MinSum can be set multiple times.
Replace modifier body to always allow re-entry (no locking), removing the require and assignment statements.
Remove the modifier nonReentrant_ from SetLogFile so the function can be called repeatedly without reverting, changing its externally observable behavior.
